{{Quote|You don't believe. I've seen the doubt in you. As I did in Wry.|Seer, to Soldier|<ref name="Riptide" />}}
'''Wry''', originally designated "'''Subject H'''," was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] created from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] in an [[Imperial research facility]] on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] at some point around [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. A part of a clone project started by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Subject H and the other clones developed a close [[Community]] between themselves, and one of them, [[Seer (clone)|Seer]], claimed to have received summons from an entity called "[[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]]" and tried to convince them to escape from the facility. Wry doubted the existence of [[Parent/Legends|Mother]], however, and was brutally [[Death/Legends|murdered]] in response by the other members of the Community [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to [[41 ABY]]. His death put caution into [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], another clone with wavering faith in Mother, who chose to comply with the plans of his brethren.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Subject H was killed by the other Subjects in an incident of collective&hellip; rage. We are unsure what sparked the incident.|Dr. Black, in his hololog|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
At some point around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Clone birth date" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] established a [[Imperial research facility|research facility]] on the surface of a [[frozen moon]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] a [[Unidentified gas giant (UR-2212-GR system)|gas giant]] in a [[UR-2212-GR system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> Having recently discovered the [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|storage]] of [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]s,<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Thrawn sent at least one of them to the facility along with the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of various [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], including that of Palpatine. The [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] at the facility were then tasked with combining the DNA to create hybrid Jedi&ndash;Sith [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to serve the Empire's needs. "Subject H," a [[Gender/Legends|male]], was among the nine clones created at the facility. Although the scientists tried to slow down the clones' maturation process, Subject H and the other clones still rapidly grew to maturity. They then underwent memory-imprinting procedures and were constantly experimented on by the scientists. The clones, kept in confinement inside the facility, exhibited a strong connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], particularly its [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], and shared an [[Force empathy/Legends|empathetic]] and [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] connection to each other.<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> As [[Time/Legends|time]] went by, the clones formed a close [[Community]], giving each other names instead of their "Subject" designations, and Subject H received the name "Wry." Most of the clones, with the exception of the one called [[Soldier (clone)|Soldier]], were imperfect, suffering from a [[sickness]] that made them [[Gene/Legends|genetically]] and emotionally unstable, and they required constant injections of the drug [[metacycline]] to combat the disease.<ref name="Riptide" />

Years before [[41 ABY]],<ref name="ERC" /> one of the other clones, a female named [[Seer (clone)|Seer]], informed Wry and the rest of the clones that she had received a call from the Force from an entity called "[[Mother (Rakatan entity)|Mother]]." She claimed that [[Parent/Legends|Mother]] called the clones to her, offering home and salvation from the sickness, but Wry doubted Seer's [[Force vision/Legends|visions]] and the existence of Mother. When Wry spoke his mind, his fellow clones violently killed him, tearing him apart in a fit of collective rage. The only clone who did not participate in the carnage was Soldier, who secretly shared Wry's doubts.<ref name="Riptide" /> One of the scientists working on the clone project, [[Dr. Black]], later documented Wry's death in an entry in his [[Holojournal/Legends|holojournal]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> Having witnessed what had happened to Wry, Soldier kept his doubts to himself and stoically proceeded with the Community's plans to escape from the frozen [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The clones eventually [[Carnage on the frozen moon|killed]] their Imperial masters and [[Mission to the frozen moon|escaped]] from the facility, and they did [[Mission to Mother|find]] Mother&mdash;a self-aware [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]&mdash;who, despite Wry's doubts, was real. However, Mother's summonses were a trap, as she intended to [[Possession/Legends|possess]] one of the clones to escape from the confinement of the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station.<ref name="Riptide" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|&hellip;appear to have an unusual connection to one another, empathetic certainly. Possibly telepathic. This was unexpected.|Dr. Black|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
Wry was a clone of a male individual,<ref name="Riptide" /> grown to maturity at an accelerated rate and, like the other clones of his kind, aware of his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] from his creation. He shared a connection to the other clones, sensing their thoughts and emotions.<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> Wry suffered from the sickness that affected all the clones except Soldier. Wry did not believe Seer's visions, doubting that "Mother" existed. He was not afraid to voice his thought to the other clones, only to be killed for doing so.<ref name="Riptide" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|Memory imprinting will begin soon, though the subjects appear to have been born with extant knowledge of their Force sensitivity. All have exhibited mastery of basic and moderately advanced Force techniques. Testing reveals an extraordinarily high midi-chlorian count in all subjects. Grand Admiral Thrawn has been apprised of the results.|Dr. Black|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
Like all other clones in the Community, Wry exhibited a strong connection with the Force, having a high [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] count and being able to skillfully use basic and some moderately advanced [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. He and the other clones were inherently attuned to the dark side, making them [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Subject H, one of the clones created on the frozen moon, was first mentioned in ''[[Crosscurrent]]'', a [[2010]] novel by [[Paul S. Kemp]]. He was mentioned in Kemp's [[2011]] sequel to ''Crosscurrent'', [[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']], which established the clone's name as "Wry." The novels revealed neither Wry's genetic template nor [[Species/Legends|species]], only revealing that he was a male.<ref name="Crosscurrent" /><ref name="Riptide" />
